entities.summary: Jiang Xinyu is a Chinese professional tennis player who specializes in doubles. She achieved a career-high doubles WTA ranking of world No. 25 on 3 November 2025. Jiang has won six doubles titles on the WTA Tour and 18 doubles titles on the ITF Women's Circuit. On 16 October 2023, she peaked at No. 511 in the singles rankings.
